dialogue_texts: Yukari
Even in the quietest corners of the world, there are echoes.
Yukari
Meeting those rumors and truth of glohm yesterday reminded me that silence is a demand to be broken.
Yukari
And today's attempt at finding Flandre... ended in failure.
Yukari
I simply can’t go back to Yakumoshi...
Later that night...
Yukari
Sleep... a time I love from the hours from sunset to sunrise...
Uhh, My Majesty?
Yukari
Sir, I don’t wish to be disturbed at this hour. What is it?
You have to return to the Shirogane Manor.
Yukari
Must I!? I just finished putting things back in order. What could possibly have gone wrong so quickly?
Fusana's been glohmed again.
Yukari
Again? Does that mean glohm is persistent? It seems someone else is quite intent on making my habit of chasing evil a permanent job. Anyway, who has done it now?
No clue. While I was on the way to the shrine, I noticed some other individuals had been infected!
Yukari
Then it seems my work is never truly done.
This is so serious that I'm going with you this time.
Yukari
If they want to test the patience of a queen, I shall be happy to provide a lesson on how reality handles pests.
Exactly! There have been confirmed cases of human-to-human transmission.
Yukari
Very well then - let us return.
To be continued in The Bewildering Parallel...
